Man Accused of Faking Eye Surgery Appeal, Raising ₹1.5 Lakh Online

Jay Singh Rathore is accused of orchestrating a scam where he allegedly faked an appeal for eye surgery, successfully raising ₹1.5 lakh through online donations, primarily on the platform X (formerly Twitter). The details of what happened after the funds were raised are being investigated.
